depiction.primary_object: tilted pencil or stylus tip drawing a wavy squiggle line
depiction.composition: diagonal pencil on right with curved line on left

readings.meaning: handwrite, scribble, or annotate by hand

ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic edit/write pencil icon, or the squiggle might look like the digit 2 or letter S at very small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: freehand drawing, sketching, or signing action

task_intents: buy sketching pencils or stylus tips
draw a floor plan or layout
